The standard of 0.2% per day for liquidated damages stipulated in the "Cooperation Agreement" was set for the obligation of Zhongdai Telecom Company to buy back the equity involved in the lawsuit from Dabao Company for RMB 52.85 million. Since the condition for Zhongdai Telecom Company to buy back the equity for RMB 52.85 million was not met, the 0.2% per day standard cannot be applied to calculate Zhongdai Telecom Company's liability for breach of contract. Dabao Company's reliance on the amount of liquidated damages calculated under this standard as a reference also lacks legal basis, and we do not accept it. The second instance judgment's use of the liquidated damages calculated at 0.2% per day on the principal of RMB 32,153,721 as a reference for Dabao Company's losses was inappropriate, and we correct this. Dabao Company's claim that its loss upon withdrawal from the cooperation was RMB 22.85 million lacks factual basis, and we do not support it. After Dabao Company withdrew from the cooperation on February 23, 2006, the "Cooperation Agreement" could no longer be performed. Dabao Company also claimed that the agreement was rescinded, so we confirm that the agreement has been rescinded. After the rescission of the "Cooperation Agreement," Zhongdai Telecom Company should return the equity transfer price of RMB 30 million paid by Dabao Company. Zhongdai Telecom Company has not returned this amount to Dabao Company to date and should compensate Dabao Company for the losses incurred. The loss should be calculated from February 24, 2006, at the loan interest rate for the corresponding period published by the People's Bank of China.

After Dabao Company sent a letter to Zhongdai Group Company on February 23, 2006, requesting withdrawal from the cooperation, Zhongdai Group Company issued a "Letter of Undertaking" to Dabao Company on June 9, 2006, agreeing to repay the RMB 30 million paid by Dabao Company. The validity of this "Letter of Undertaking" is unrelated to whether the "Cooperation Contract" exists. After Dabao Company accepted the "Letter of Undertaking" without objection, Zhongdai Group Company should be bound by it. Zhongdai Group Company's argument that it should not bear the liability for repayment to Dabao Company contradicts the "Letter of Undertaking," and we do not support its claim. Zhongdai Group Company should bear joint and several liability for Zhongdai Telecom Company's obligation to repay Dabao Company. Zhongshan Company undertook in the "Cooperation Agreement" to provide a guarantee for the obligations and liabilities of Zhongdai Telecom Company and assumed joint and several liability. After Dabao Company withdrew from the cooperation, Zhongshan Company should still bear joint and several liability for Zhongdai Telecom Company's obligation to return the funds. Zhongdai Group Company objected to the Guangdong High Court's ruling dismissing its retrial application. Since this case has been taken up for retrial by this Court, we will no longer consider Zhongdai Group Company's objection.

In summary, the "Cooperation Agreement" is valid. Dabao Company performed its payment obligation of RMB 30 million as stipulated in the agreement. After Dabao Company withdrew from the cooperation, the agreement was rescinded. Zhongdai Telecom Company should return the RMB 30 million paid by Dabao Company and should pay interest losses caused to Dabao Company due to the failure to return the funds in a timely manner. We support Dabao Company's claim for rescission of the "Cooperation Agreement" and its request for Zhongdai Telecom Company to return the RMB 30 million and corresponding interest. Dabao Company's request for Zhongdai Telecom Company to pay loss compensation of RMB 22.85 million and corresponding interest is difficult to establish, and we do not support it. Zhongdai Group Company and Zhongshan Company should bear joint and several liability for Zhongdai Telecom Company's obligation to return the funds. The first and second instance judgments found the facts generally clear, but applied the law incorrectly, and we correct them.
